lines: Step between the rows, not across them. What do you need?
Morning. I have soil on my hands, but I can listen.
If you came to help, the spare hoe is by the fence.
Come closer before the wind carries your words away.
I have a minute before the water reaches the next bed.
Mind that seed tray. It took all morning to sort.
You caught me checking the leaves for pests.
Hello. Did you need me or the bread?
Stand in the shade if you plan to stay awhile.
The field can spare me for a short conversation.
If this is about the fence, I already know.
Good to see you. The weather has been less polite.
Wipe your boots if you are heading inside afterward.
I was just counting what survived the last rain.
Come by the composter. It is quieter there.
You look hungry. Talk first, then we will find something.
I can listen while I tie these stalks.
Careful near the irrigation ditch. Now, what is it?
The animals are fed and the rows are watered. Your timing is good.
Go on. I am taking a break before my back decides for me.
